name: progress
description: Labeled progress. Never a bar with no name. Determinate announces a percent; indeterminate reads Loading.
avoidWhen: Do not use for a button wait; use the button loading state. Do not omit the label.

ux.behaviour: A label sits above the bar; determinate progress announces a percent
ux.why: A nameless bar is a rumor

ux.behaviour: Null progress is indeterminate and reads Loading

aiHints: Always pass a label; do not wrap a LinearProgressIndicator yourself
Use tertiary for the bar — it is a signal, not a button
